NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Block Play Store updates
patches.description: Keep the Play Store from replacing your patched app by raising its version code to Android's limit. Some apps may have compatibility issues, and root-mounted installs aren't supported.

patches.name: Choose install source
patches.description: Choose which app store the app sees as its installer, such as Google Play.

patches.name: Enable local PRO
patches.description: Turn on PRO features controlled by the app and keep the Switch to PRO toggle out of settings. This doesn't create a purchase or unlock server-only perks.

patches.name: Hide banner ads
patches.description: Clear banner ads and their empty spaces from the map, navigation and home screen. Road alerts and route controls stay in place.

patches.name: Inspect app traffic
patches.description: Let a debugging proxy inspect the app's traffic by bypassing certificate pinning.

patches.name: Install a second copy
patches.description: Install another copy using a different package name. Adds ".morphe" by default; each copy needs its own name. Some apps don't support cloning and may crash or lose features.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Choose a unique package name for this copy, or leave Default to add .morphe.

options.title: Update permissions
options.description: Renames the app's custom permissions so the copies can be installed together. This can break features in some apps.

options.title: Update providers
options.description: Renames the app's providers so the copies can be installed together. This can break features in some apps.

patches.name: Mute voice ads
patches.description: Keep your drive free of sponsored audio and spoken ad campaigns. Navigation directions and road warnings still play normally.

patches.name: Reduce tracking
patches.description: Stop the tracking and ad-reporting services covered by this patch, including usage analytics, location targeting, Wi-Fi/app scans and crash uploads. Also blocks RevenueCat, so purchases and subscription syncing won't work. Navigation and sign-in stay online and may still send identifiers or location.

patches.name: Skip startup ads
patches.description: Open Yanosik without startup ads, including campaigns already saved on your phone. Regular startup messages and account checks still work.

patches.name: Use the original app signature
patches.description: Let the app see its original APK signature when it checks its own package.

patches.name: Vibe settings and fewer PRO prompts
patches.description: Open Vibe settings from the home screen and choose a saved dark theme for home, login, search and maps with a Material 3 toggle. Dark mode starts on. Hides PRO upgrade cards and purchase pages, plus donation prompts in settings. Direct donation and voucher pages still open.
